```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

**Aim: Create updated metasheet for full RCC cohort and visualize a cohort heatmap**

### Load metadata csv files

```{r load and combine meta, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)

#General metadata
Meta_224_G <- as.data.frame(read_xls("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/TMA224_update_LM.xls",col_names = T))
Meta_20_G <- as.data.frame(read_xls("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/ZTMA20_update_LM.xls",col_names = T))

#IHC and TMA coord data
Meta_224_IHC <- as.data.frame(read_xls("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/TMA224_IHC_Loc_LM.xls",col_names = T))
Meta_20_IHC <- as.data.frame(read_xls("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/TMA20_IHC_Loc_LM.xls",col_names = T))

Meta_224 <- left_join(Meta_224_G,Meta_224_IHC,by=c("PID","type")) %>% mutate_all(as.character)
Meta_20 <- left_join(Meta_20_G,Meta_20_IHC,by=c("PID","type","x")) %>% mutate_all(as.character)

Meta <- bind_rows(Meta_20,Meta_224)


##double-check that entries are distinct
#duplicated PID from primary samples (normal samples often have a match)
#different tumors from the same patient for B1997.28921 and B2000.35726
#two replicates for B1997.23862 (internal control?)
dup <- Meta %>% 
  filter(type == "primary") %>%
  count(PID) %>% 
  filter(n>1) %>% 
  pull(PID)

Meta_PID_dup <- Meta %>% filter(PID %in% dup) %>% arrange(PID)
```

### Tidy up data for processing and display

```{r tidy}
library(DT)
library(prodlim)

Meta$PID <- str_replace_all(Meta$PID," ", "")
Meta$subtype <- str_replace_all(Meta$subtype," ", "_")
Meta$gender <- str_replace_all(Meta$gender,"w","f")
Meta$necrose <- str_replace(Meta$necrose, "\\?", "")
Meta$lymphocytes <- str_replace(Meta$lymphocytes, "\\?", "")
#Note: Converted ISUP grade 4? into 4 (Patient: B2013.54303)
Meta$ISUP <- str_replace(Meta$ISUP, "\\?", "")

Meta[Meta== ""] <- NA

#Age bin for patients (five groups)
Meta$age <- as.numeric(Meta$age)
Meta <- Meta %>% mutate(age_bin = ifelse(age <= 40, "27-40", 
                                   ifelse(40<age & age<=55, "41-55",
                                          ifelse(55<age & age<=70, "56-70",
                                                 ifelse(70<age & age<=85, "71-85",
                                                        ifelse(85<age & age<=90, "85-88",NA))))))
#Survival data availability
Meta <- Meta %>% mutate(survival_data = ifelse(!is.na(survival_months),TRUE,FALSE))

##Sequencing data availability 
#Targeted seq
as.data.frame(read_xlsx("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/TMA1+2_ccRCC_IHCMut_LM.xlsx",col_names = T)) %>% 
  mutate_all(as.character) %>% mutate(sequencing_data = ifelse(!is.na(BAP1_mut),TRUE,FALSE)) %>%
  filter(sequencing_data == TRUE) %>%
  pull(PID) %>% 
  str_replace_all(" ", "") -> PID_seq

PID_seq_2 <- as.data.frame(read.table("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/04_Originalfiles_Not_corrected/samplesRCC_seq_Aashil.txt",header = TRUE)) %>% filter(Cohort == "826_gene_panel" & !is.na(Bnumber_cor)) %>% pull(Bnumber_cor)

PID_seq_2[!PID_seq_2 %in% PID_seq] #"B2008.13725" = chromophobe RCC?, "B2011.1970" = normal tissue? double-check that with Schraml

Meta <- Meta %>% mutate(tar_sequencing_data = ifelse(PID %in% PID_seq,TRUE,FALSE))

#WES
WES_seq <- as.data.frame(read.table("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/04_Originalfiles_Not_corrected/samplesRCC_seq_Aashil.txt",header = TRUE)) %>% filter(Cohort == "WES" & !is.na(Bnumber_cor)) %>% pull(Bnumber_cor)

Meta <- Meta %>% mutate(WES_data = ifelse(PID %in% WES_seq,TRUE,FALSE))

#Lack of tissue on TMAs
kick_out <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/TMA20_224_emptycores_kickout.xlsx",col_names = T,na = "NA")) %>% 
  mutate_all(as.character)

Meta$no_tissue <- !is.na(row.match(Meta %>% select(grid,x,y,TMA),kick_out))

#Arrange 
colnames(Meta)
Meta <- Meta %>% select(1,"TMA", "grid","x","y","spot",4,3,"age_bin","type","subtype","comment","ISUP","pT_simple","pT12/34","necrose","lymphocytes","BAP1_IHC","PBRM1_IHC","H3K36me_IHC","survival_months", "censor_dead_0_alive_1", "survival_data", "tar_sequencing_data","WES_data","no_tissue")

#Save fully annotated metadata as csv
write.csv(Meta, file = "/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv", row.names = F)

#Filter data for primary tumors
Meta_PT <- Meta %>% filter(type == "primary") 

#Save fully annotated metadata for primary tumors as csv
write.csv(Meta_PT, file = "/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv", row.names = F)

#Show overview of updated and processed metadata-table for primary tumors
datatable(Meta)
```


### Print heatmap based overview
based on the [ComplexHeatmap](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ComplexHeatmap.html) package and the implemented `HeatmapAnnotation` function  

```{r viz, message=F, fig.width=16, fig.height=9, fig.align='center'}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(foreach)
library(ggsci)
library(RColorBrewer)

#Filter for columns to visualize
Meta_viz <- meta_fil %>% select(PID, gender, age_bin, subtype, ISUP, pT_simple, necrose, lymphocytes, BAP1_IHC, PBRM1_IHC, H3K36me_IHC, survival_data,tar_sequencing_data,WES_data)

Meta_viz <- as.data.frame(lapply(Meta_viz, as.character))

#Convert empty columns and NAs for easier handling with ComplexHeatmap package
Meta_viz[is.na(Meta_viz)] <- "Unknown"

Meta_viz <- Meta_viz %>% arrange(subtype, desc(pT_simple), desc(ISUP))

#Color scheme
#colnames(Meta_viz)
col <- list(PID = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$PID))),
           gender = c("#7FC97F", "#BEAED4"),
           age_bin = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$age_bin))-1),"black"),
           subtype = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$subtype))-1),"black"),
           pT_simple = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$pT_simple))-1),"black"),
           ISUP = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$ISUP))-1),"black"),
           necrose = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Purples"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$necrose))-1),"black"),
           lymphocytes = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$lymphocytes))-1),"black"),
           BAP1_IHC = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Oranges"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$BAP1_IHC))-1),"black"),
           PBRM1_IHC = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Oranges"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$PBRM1_IHC))-1),"black"),
           H3K36me_IHC = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Oranges"))(length(unique(Meta_viz$H3K36me_IHC))-1),"black"),
           survival_data = c("black","grey"),
           WES_data = c("black","grey"),
           tar_sequencing_data = c("black","grey")
)

col_list_1 <- foreach(i=1:14, .packages="foreach") %do% {
  color= col[[i]]
  names(color)= sort(unique(Meta_viz[,names(col)[i]]))
  color
}
names(col_list_1) <- c(names(col))

#Save color list object for downstream usage
saveRDS(col_list_1,file="/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/color.rds")

#Heatmap Annotation
sample_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(PID = Meta_viz$PID,
                                gender = Meta_viz$gender,
                                age_bin = Meta_viz$age_bin,
                                subtype = Meta_viz$subtype,
                                pT_simple = Meta_viz$pT_simple,
                                ISUP = Meta_viz$ISUP,
                                necrose = Meta_viz$necrose,
                                lymphocytes = Meta_viz$lymphocytes,
                                BAP1_IHC = Meta_viz$BAP1_IHC,
                                PBRM1_IHC = Meta_viz$PBRM1_IHC,
                                H3K36me_IHC = Meta_viz$H3K36me_IHC,
                                survival_data = Meta_viz$survival_data,
                                tar_sequencing_data = Meta_viz$tar_sequencing_data,
                                WES_data = Meta_viz$WES_data,
                                col = col_list_1,
                                border = T,
                                na_col = "black",
                                gap = unit(5, "points"),
                                show_annotation_name = T,
                                show_legend = c(PID = FALSE)
                                #annotation_label = c("PID (n=367)","Gender","Subtype","pT","pN")
)%v%NULL

#Display plot
draw(sample_anno)
```

### Reproduce findings from Bihr et al. (2019) for ccRCC

see [here](https://www.zora.uzh.ch/id/eprint/171731/1/Bihr_Neoplasia_2019.pdf) for the full publication.

Contingency table analysis and Pearson's chi-square tests were used to analyze the associations between PBRM1, BAP1 and SETD2 expression patterns, gene mutations and pathological parameters in ccRCC.

```{r reproduce birch, fig.width=8,fig.height=5, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(sjPlot)

#Groupings in Bihr et al. 
#T1/T2 (organ-confined) vs. T3/T4 (advanced)
Meta_viz_cc <- Meta_viz_cc %>% 
  mutate(pT_comb = ifelse(pT_simple == 1|pT_simple == 2, "1/2", 
                  ifelse(pT_simple == 3|pT_simple == 4, "3/4", NA))) %>%
  mutate(ISUP_comb = ifelse(ISUP == 1|ISUP == 2, "1/2", 
                  ifelse(ISUP == 3, "3", 
                         ifelse(ISUP == 4, "4", NA)))) %>%
  na_if("Unknown")

#Perform Chi-Square test and visualize
plot_xtab(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$ISUP_comb, bar.pos = "stack", margin = "row",show.prc = FALSE,vjust = +0.5, geom.colors = "Reds")+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("BAP1 IHC")+
  ylab("Fraction [%]")+
  ggtitle(paste0("P=",chisq.test(table(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$ISUP_comb))$p.value," [Chi-squared]"))

plot_xtab(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$pT_comb, bar.pos = "stack", margin = "row",show.prc = FALSE,vjust = +0.5, geom.colors = "Blues")+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("BAP1 IHC")+
  ylab("Fraction [%]")+
  ggtitle(paste0("P=",chisq.test(table(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$pT_comb))$p.value," [Chi-squared]"))

plot_xtab(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$necrose, bar.pos = "stack", margin = "row",show.prc = FALSE,vjust = +0.5, geom.colors = unname(col_list_1[["necrose"]]))+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("BAP1 IHC")+
  ylab("Fraction [%]")+
  ggtitle(paste0("P=",chisq.test(table(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$necrose))$p.value," [Chi-squared]"))


plot_xtab(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$lymphocytes, bar.pos = "stack", margin = "row",show.prc = FALSE,vjust = +0.5, geom.colors = unname(col_list_1[["lymphocytes"]]))+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("BAP1 IHC")+
  ylab("Fraction [%]")+
  ggtitle(paste0("P=",chisq.test(table(Meta_viz_cc$BAP1_IHC,Meta_viz_cc$lymphocytes))$p.value," [Chi-squared]"))

#Results are reproducible
```


### Randomized Stratified Sampling based on clinical metadata for targeted sequencing

```{r seq selection, message=FALSE, warnings=FALSE,fig.width=14, fig.height=9, fig.align='center'}
###Filter for major RCC classes and cases for which we do not have any sequencing data but do have tissue on the TMA
Meta_seq = Meta_PT %>% 
  filter(subtype == "clear_cell_RCC" & tar_sequencing_data == "FALSE" & WES_data == "FALSE",no_tissue == "FALSE" & survival_data == "TRUE" & !is.na(Meta_PT$ISUP) & !is.na(Meta_PT$pT_simple)) %>%
  select(PID, gender, age_bin, subtype, ISUP,pT_simple, "pT12/34", necrose, lymphocytes, BAP1_IHC, PBRM1_IHC, H3K36me_IHC, survival_data,tar_sequencing_data,WES_data)


##Random stratified sampling by tumor stage
#slice by number of samples per group
set.seed(11)
Meta_seq_select <- Meta_seq %>% group_by(pT_simple) %>% slice_sample(n=8)
Meta_seq_notselected <- Meta_seq %>% filter(!PID %in% Meta_seq_select$PID)

set.seed(11)
Meta_seq_select_1 <- Meta_seq_notselected %>% group_by(pT_simple) %>% slice_sample(n=16)
Meta_seq_notselected_2 <- Meta_seq %>% filter(!PID %in% c(Meta_seq_select$PID,Meta_seq_select_1$PID))

set.seed(11)
Meta_seq_select_2 <- Meta_seq_notselected_2 %>% group_by(pT_simple) %>% slice_sample(n=6)
Meta_seq_notselected_3 <- Meta_seq %>% filter(!PID %in% c(Meta_seq_select$PID,Meta_seq_select_1$PID,Meta_seq_select_2$PID))

Manual_PID <- c("B2012.59545","B2011.54740","B2013.21535")
Meta_seq_select_3 <- Meta_seq %>% filter(PID %in% Manual_PID)

Meta_seq_select_final <- rbind(Meta_seq_select,Meta_seq_select_1,Meta_seq_select_2,Meta_seq_select_3)
Meta_seq_select_final %>% group_by(ISUP) %>% count()
Meta_seq_select_final %>% group_by(pT_simple) %>% count()
Meta_seq_select_final <- Meta_seq_select_final %>% arrange(subtype, desc(pT_simple), desc(ISUP))

#Heatmap Annotation
sample_anno_seq <- HeatmapAnnotation(PID = Meta_seq_select_final$PID,
                                gender = Meta_seq_select_final$gender,
                                age_bin = Meta_seq_select_final$age_bin,
                                subtype = Meta_seq_select_final$subtype,
                                pT_simple = Meta_seq_select_final$pT_simple,
                                ISUP = Meta_seq_select_final$ISUP,
                                necrose = Meta_seq_select_final$necrose,
                                lymphocytes = Meta_seq_select_final$lymphocytes,
                                BAP1_IHC = Meta_seq_select_final$BAP1_IHC,
                                PBRM1_IHC = Meta_seq_select_final$PBRM1_IHC,
                                H3K36me_IHC = Meta_seq_select_final$H3K36me_IHC,
                                survival_data = Meta_seq_select_final$survival_data,
                                tar_sequencing_data = Meta_seq_select_final$tar_sequencing_data,
                                WES_data = Meta_seq_select_final$WES_data,
                                col = col_list_1,
                                border = T,
                                na_col = "black",
                                gap = unit(5, "points"),
                                show_annotation_name = T,
                                show_legend = c(PID = FALSE)
                                #annotation_label = c("PID (n=367)","Gender","Subtype","pT","pN")
)%v%NULL

#Display plot
draw(sample_anno_seq)

#Save metadata for targeted sequencing tumors as csv
write.csv(Meta_seq_select_final, file = "/Users/lasmey/Desktop/RCC/Metadaten/Metadata_TargetedSeq_RCC_Batch1.csv", row.names = F)
```
